summary: This is a 424B5 prospectus supplement for Haoxi Health Technology Ltd's registered direct offering of 9,000,000 Class A ordinary shares and 16,999,998 pre-funded warrants. The offering price is $0.25 per share and $0.2474 per warrant for gross proceeds up to $6.46M. Last sale price was $0.045 on May 11, 2026. Univest Securities acts as placement agent on a best-efforts basis without escrow. The filing is a capital-raising transaction, not a special situation; it does not involve acquisitions, divestitures, or other event-driven categories.
